config.notes: Swinburne course pages (www.swinburne.edu.au/course/<level>/<slug>), plain HTML, no page data. Fees: each page prints a domestic panel ("2026 tuition fees" or "2026 fees": Yearly fee + Total fee) then an international panel (same heading, Yearly fee only, $0.00 when not offered to international students); fee = last Yearly fee not followed by Total fee (2026 figures; catalogue holds the 2027 schedule from the international fee PDFs). Start dates: "<term> Location <campus> Start dates DD-Month-YYYY" in the Apply panel; only Australian campuses and Online read (Colombo/Sarawak pathway intakes skipped); empty panel = no international intake listed. IELTS: "IELTS overall band of X (Academic Module) with no individual band below Y". Central: English https://www.swinburne.edu.au/study/international/apply/entry-requirements/ ; dates https://www.swinburne.edu.au/courses/intakes/start-dates-intakes/ (Semester 1 = March, Semester 2 = August; UniLink Pathways 1/2/3 = February/June/October; TAFE February/July intakes). Delivery: the international view prints no delivery words, only the location in the Apply panel; mode reads "Online" only when every Apply-panel location nearby is Online (100% online); campus-only courses give no mode reading. Entry requirement (Platform Admin 15:36): "Course prerequisites <text>" (undergraduate) or "Qualifications <text>" (postgraduate), up to the first full stop (max 200 characters), shown for review only. Exit awards: postgraduate pages print graduate certificates/diplomas as "exit award only" by units completed (e.g. "4 Core units + 2 Core units = Graduate diploma"), never in full-time years, so no exit_awards pattern.
